verdict.rationale: Business-hours routing is a fair question for a business phone platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents only adjacent call-routing features: custom ring orders, call transfers, phone menus, routing calls to the right person, and Sona answering when the team can't. Nothing shows per-number business hours with distinct open, closed, or holiday behavior.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
